com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai

Interface LDAIConfigTracker


  • public interface LDAIConfigTracker
    Reports events related to a single AI run of an AIConfig.

    A tracker is obtained from a retrieved config via AIConfig.createTracker(), or reconstructed from a resumption token via LDAIClient.createTracker(String, com.launchdarkly.sdk.LDContext). Each tracker corresponds to one AI run and is used to record metrics such as model usage, duration, and feedback against the AI Config it was created from.

    Most tracking methods are at-most-once: a second call to the same method on the same tracker is silently dropped. trackToolCall(String) and #trackJudgeResult(JudgeResult) are multi-fire — each call records a distinct event.

    Implementations are thread-safe.

    • Method Detail

      • getTrackData

        LDAITrackingTypes.TrackData getTrackData()
        Returns the correlation metadata for this tracker's run.
        Returns:
        the track data, never null

      • getResumptionToken

        java.lang.String getResumptionToken()
        Returns the resumption token for this run.

        The resumption token encodes the run's identity and can be passed to LDAIClient.createTracker(String, com.launchdarkly.sdk.LDContext) to reconstruct a tracker on a subsequent request (for example, in a streaming scenario).

        Security note: resumption tokens embed flag-evaluation details such as the variation key and config version. Keep tokens server-side and do not round-trip them through untrusted clients where they could leak flag-targeting information.

        Returns:
        the resumption token, or null if not available

      • trackDuration

        void trackDuration(java.time.Duration duration)
        Records the duration of the AI generation.

        At-most-once: subsequent calls on the same tracker are silently dropped.

        Parameters:
        duration - the duration; ignored if null

      • trackDurationOf

        <T> T trackDurationOf(java.util.concurrent.Callable<T> operation)
               throws java.lang.Exception
        Executes the given operation and records its wall-clock duration.

        The duration is recorded even if the operation throws. Equivalent to wrapping the operation in a try/finally that calls trackDuration(Duration).

        Type Parameters:
        T - the return type of the operation
        Parameters:
        operation - the operation to execute and time; must not be null
        Returns:
        the result of the operation
        Throws:
        java.lang.Exception - if the operation throws

      • trackTimeToFirstToken

        void trackTimeToFirstToken(java.time.Duration duration)
        Records the time from request start to receipt of the first token.

        At-most-once: subsequent calls on the same tracker are silently dropped.

        Parameters:
        duration - the time to first token; ignored if null

      • trackSuccess

        void trackSuccess()
        Records that the AI generation succeeded.

        At-most-once and mutually exclusive with trackError(): whichever is called first wins.

      • trackError

        void trackError()
        Records that the AI generation failed.

        At-most-once and mutually exclusive with trackSuccess(): whichever is called first wins.

      • trackFeedback

        At-most-once: subsequent calls on the same tracker are silently dropped.

      • trackTokens

        void trackTokens(LDAITrackingTypes.TokenUsage tokens)
        Records token usage for this AI generation.

        At-most-once: subsequent calls on the same tracker are silently dropped. Calls where all counts are zero do not consume the at-most-once slot.

        Parameters:
        tokens - the token usage; ignored if null

      • trackToolCall

        void trackToolCall(java.lang.String toolKey)
        Records a single tool call made during this AI generation.

        Multi-fire: every call emits an event.

        Parameters:
        toolKey - the tool key; ignored if null

      • trackToolCalls

        void trackToolCalls(java.util.List<java.lang.String> toolKeys)
        Records multiple tool calls made during this AI generation.

        Equivalent to calling trackToolCall(String) for each key.

        Parameters:
        toolKeys - the tool keys; ignored if null

      • trackJudgeResult

        void trackJudgeResult(LDAITrackingTypes.JudgeResult result)
        Records the result of a judge evaluation.

        Multi-fire per judge metric key. The result is silently skipped if it was not sampled, if the evaluation did not succeed, or if the metric key or score is absent.

        Parameters:
        result - the judge result; ignored if null

      • trackMetricsOf

        <T> T trackMetricsOf(java.util.function.Function<? super T,LDAITrackingTypes.AIMetrics> metricsExtractor,
                     java.util.concurrent.Callable<T> operation)
              throws java.lang.Exception
        Executes the given operation and tracks its metrics using the extracted LDAITrackingTypes.AIMetrics.

        Tracks duration (preferring runner-reported duration when present), success or error, tokens, and tool calls. If the operation throws, trackError() is called and the exception is re-thrown.

        Type Parameters:
        T - the return type of the operation
        Parameters:
        metricsExtractor - a function that extracts LDAITrackingTypes.AIMetrics from the operation result; exceptions from the extractor propagate to the caller
        operation - the AI operation to execute; must not be null
        Returns:
        the result of the operation
        Throws:
        java.lang.Exception - if the operation or the metrics extractor throws

      • getSummary

        LDAITrackingTypes.MetricSummary getSummary()
        Returns a snapshot of all metrics tracked so far on this tracker.
        Returns:
        the metric summary, never null
